info.title: PODFY Open API
info.description:
Read records (proofs of delivery and reports) and update their status from your own systems, manage your reference (asset) register, and approve refund requests and report their payout result.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request. Keys are created by a brand admin in the portal (Settings → Integrations → API keys) and shown once. `pk_live_…` keys see only production records; `pk_test_…` keys ("QA records only") see only test records from qa.podfy.app (podfy_id starting with `QA-`). A key never works in a query parameter. A missing, malformed, unknown or revoked key always gets the same `401 invalid_key`.

**Availability.** The Open API is part of PODFY Advanced. When it is not active for the brand, every call answers `403 feature_not_active`.

**Scopes.** `records:read`, `records:write`, `references:read`, `references:write`, `refunds:read`, `refunds:write`. A write scope also allows reading the same resource; nothing else is implied. Missing scope: `403 insufficient_scope`.

**Rate limit.** 600 requests per minute per key (fixed one-minute windows). Every answer carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (unix seconds when the window ends). Above the limit: `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After` (seconds).

**Isolation.** A record, reference or refund of another brand, or a record or refund of the other environment, answers `404 not_found`, never 403.

**Refunds.** PODFY records refund requests from the report form and never pays them out. A brand admin (in the portal) or your system (`POST /refunds/{id}/approve`) approves a request; PODFY then sends the signed webhook `refund.approved` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name. Your payment platform pays and reports back with `POST /refunds/{id}/result`. Use the refund `id` as the idempotency key: sending the same result again answers the same refund and changes nothing.

**Paging.** List endpoints return `{data, next_cursor}`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it is `null`. Records are newest first. Cursors are opaque.

**Errors.** Every error is JSON `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}}`. Responses are never cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`). No CORS: call the API from your server, never from a browser.

tags.name: References
tags.description: The reference (asset) register; requires the asset register to be active

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Refund requests from the report form; requires refund requests to be active (part of Advanced)

get.description:
Records of your brand, newest first. Deleted records are never listed.

Required scope: `records:read` (a key with `records:write` may also call it).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only records created at or after this moment (ISO 8601 date or date-time; a time without zone is UTC).

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only records changed (or created) at or after this moment (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Work status, one or more comma separated.

get.description:
One record with its timeline (`created`, `status`, `comment`, `assign`, `priority`, `duplicate`). Mail recipients and reporter data never appear.

Required scope: `records:read` (a key with `records:write` may also call it).

patch.description:
Change the work status, assignee or priority, or add a comment. Same rules as the portal: one timeline event per change, webhooks `record.status_changed` / `record.updated` are sent, the actor is `api:<key prefix>`. Needs status tracking (report mode or the status tracking add-on), else `403 feature_not_active`. Only the fields below are accepted.

Required scope: `records:write`.

200.description: The record after the update. `changed` is false when nothing differed.

get.description:
Your reference register, ordered by ref.

Required scope: `references:read` (a key with `references:write` may also call it).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text contained in ref, name or location (1–100 characters).

post.description:
Adds one reference. `409 ref_exists` when the ref is already in the register.

Required scope: `references:write`. QA keys (pk_test_) cannot change references: the register is shared with production records (403 insufficient_scope).

get.description:
One reference.

Required scope: `references:read` (a key with `references:write` may also call it).

patch.description:
Edit, move, retire (`status: retired`) or reactivate a reference. Only the fields below are accepted; an empty string clears a text field.

Required scope: `references:write`. QA keys (pk_test_) cannot change references: the register is shared with production records (403 insufficient_scope).

get.description:
Refund requests of the brand, newest first.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:read` (a key with `refunds:write` may also call it).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Refund status, one or more comma separated.

get.description:
One refund request.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:read` (a key with `refunds:write` may also call it).

post.description:
Moves a `requested` refund to `approved` (actor `api:<key prefix>`). Sends the webhook `refund.approved` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name (never to `*`). Any other status: `409 invalid_transition`. The body is optional.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:write`.

Moves a `requested` refund to `rejected` (actor `api:<key prefix>`). Sends the webhook `refund.updated` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name (never to `*`). Any other status: `409 invalid_transition`. The body is optional.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:write`.

Your payment platform reports the result of an `approved` refund: `paid` or `failed`. Sends the webhook `refund.updated` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name. Idempotent: the same status again answers `200` with the stored refund and changes nothing. A result for a refund that is not approved (or a different result after a final one): `409 invalid_transition`.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:write`.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: pk_live_… / pk_test_… (40 hex characters after the prefix)
bearerAuth.description: API key from Settings → Integrations → API keys.

podfy_id.name: podfy_id
podfy_id.description: The record's PODFY ID, e.g. PFY-7Q4K2-1 (QA-… for test records).

ref.name: ref
ref.description: The reference (1–64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen).

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Page size, 1–200 (default 50; larger values are capped at 200).

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this key (600).

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time (seconds) when the current window ends.

BadRequest.description: Invalid query parameter or body. Codes: `invalid_parameter`, `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_body`, `invalid_status`, `invalid_priority`, `invalid_assignee`, `invalid_comment`, `comment_too_long`, `nothing_to_update`, `invalid_ref`, `name_too_long`, `location_too_long`, `group_code_too_long`, `sticker_text_too_long`, `no_valid_fields`, `invalid_note`, `note_too_long`, `invalid_platform_ref`, `platform_ref_too_long`.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked (always the same body). Codes: `invalid_key`.

Forbidden.description: The Open API (or, for references, the reference register; for record updates, status tracking; for refunds, refund requests) is not active for the brand, or the key lacks the scope. Codes: `feature_not_active`, `insufficient_scope`.

NotFound.description: No such endpoint, or no such record / reference / refund for this key's brand and environment. Codes: `not_found`.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The endpoint exists but not with this method; `Allow` lists the methods. Codes: `method_not_allowed`.

RateLimited.description: More than 600 requests in this minute for this key. Codes: `rate_limited`.

ServerError.description: Unexpected error; try again later. Codes: `server_error`.

RefundConflict.description: The refund is not in a status that allows this change (requested → approved | rejected; approved → paid | failed). Codes: `invalid_transition`.

error.message: This API key does not have the records:write scope.

Record.description: The same record object as in webhook payloads, plus timestamps and the assignee.

category.description: Category code (report mode) or delivery issue code.

group_id.description: Records of one multi-file upload share it (the podfy_id without the -N suffix).

duplicate_of.description: podfy_id of the first report this one duplicates.

url.description: Public detail page of the record.

assignee.description: E-mail of the assigned brand member.

keep_informed.description: True when the reporter asked to be kept informed (a confirmation or resolved message was or can be sent). Never the address.

assignee.description: An active member of the brand, or null to unassign.

id.description: Refund id; use it as the idempotency key.

result.description: Set once the platform reported paid or failed.

podfy_id.description: The record the refund belongs to.

flags.description: e.g. `duplicate_pay_ref` (the payment reference was used by another request of this brand).

decided_by.description: Who approved or rejected: a portal user's e-mail, `auto`, or `api:<key prefix>`.

note.description: Optional note (stored with the refund, never sent in webhooks).
